topics.title: Indices and laws of indices
topics.outcome: Apply laws of indices to simplify and evaluate expressions.

questions.prompt: Evaluate 2^3 x 2^4.
Evaluate 5^0 + 3^2.
questions.solution:
Any non-zero number to the power 0 is 1, so 5^0 = 1
3^2 = 9
1 + 9 = 10

questions.prompt: Find x if 3^x = 81.
questions.solution:
Write 81 as a power of 3: 81 = 3^4
So x = 4

topics.title: Logarithms
topics.outcome: Relate indices and logarithms and evaluate simple logarithms.

questions.prompt: Evaluate log base 2 of 8.
questions.solution:
log2(8) asks: 2 to what power gives 8?
2^3 = 8
So the answer is 3

questions.prompt: Evaluate log base 10 of 1000.
If log base 5 of x = 2, find x.
questions.solution:
Change to index form: x = 5^2
x = 25

questions.prompt: When (x + 3)(x + 2) is expanded, what is the coefficient of x?
questions.solution:
(x + 3)(x + 2) = x^2 + 2x + 3x + 6
= x^2 + 5x + 6
The coefficient of x is 5

Find two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to 5: 2 and 3
So a = 3

questions.prompt: Find the value of (x + 4)^2 when x = 1.
Solve x^2 - 16 = 0. Give the positive root.
questions.solution:
x^2 = 16
x = 4 or x = -4
The positive root is 4

questions.prompt: Solve x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0. Give the larger root.
questions.solution:
Factorise: (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0
x = 2 or x = 3
The larger root is 3

questions.prompt: Solve x^2 + 2x - 15 = 0. Give the positive root.
questions.solution:
Factorise: (x + 5)(x - 3) = 0
x = -5 or x = 3
The positive root is 3

topics.title: Linear equations and inequalities
topics.outcome: Solve linear equations and inequalities in one unknown.

questions.prompt: Solve 5x - 4 = 16.
What is the smallest integer x that satisfies 2x + 3 > 11?
questions.solution:
2x > 8
x > 4
The smallest integer greater than 4 is 5

questions.prompt: What is the largest integer x that satisfies 3x - 2 < 10?
questions.solution:
3x < 12
x < 4
The largest integer less than 4 is 3

topics.title: Pythagoras' theorem
topics.outcome: Use Pythagoras' theorem to find unknown sides of right-angled triangles.

questions.prompt: A right-angled triangle has legs 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse in cm.
A right-angled triangle has legs 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse in cm.
The hypotenuse is 10 cm and one leg is 6 cm. Find the other leg in cm.

topics.title: Trigonometric ratios
topics.outcome: Use sine, cosine and tangent of acute angles.

questions.prompt: Find sin 30 degrees as a decimal.
questions.solution:
sin 30 degrees = 1/2
= 0.5

questions.prompt: In a right-angled triangle the side opposite angle t is 4 and the hypotenuse is 5. Find sin t as a decimal.
questions.solution:
sin t = opposite / hypotenuse
= 4 / 5
= 0.8

questions.prompt: Find tan 45 degrees.
questions.solution: tan 45 degrees = 1 because opposite and adjacent sides are equal

topics.title: Measures of central tendency
topics.outcome: Calculate the mean, median, mode and range of a data set.

questions.prompt: Find the mean of 4, 6, 8, 10, 12.
questions.solution:
Sum = 40
Number of values = 5
Mean = 40 / 5 = 8

questions.prompt: Find the median of 3, 9, 5, 7, 1.
questions.solution:
Order the data: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9
The middle value is 5

questions.prompt: Find the range of 4, 9, 15, 2.
questions.solution:
Largest = 15, smallest = 2
Range = 15 - 2 = 13
